# Interpolate 2D Scattered

![Interpolate 2D Scattered function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/math/interpolation/03-interpolate_2d_scattered.svg)

[Mathematics functions](../../mathematics/index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Interpolates scattered X/Y/Z observations at paired queries; the points1d and points2d variants retain vector and matrix result shapes. Methods nearest, triangulated linear, cubic and biharmonic have distinct contracts. Real DBL vectors/matrices; explicit real numeric promotion, no complex-to-real conversion, scalar lifting or broadcasting. PP uses ascending local powers as an explicit GS convention. Available variants: points2d, points1d.

<details>
<summary>Résumé français de l’aide Studio</summary>

**Interpolate 2D Scattered**

Interpole un nuage de points 2D par voisin, triangulation linéaire, cubique C1 ou biharmonique.

</details>
